status: Frozen before any new outcome distribution, fitted estimate, or comparative score is inspected.
purpose: Test an established correlated regression estimator and native held-out readouts without modifying CADE.

score_adapter.likelihood: Same rank-reduced CADE u | beta ~ N(A beta,C). Pass XtX=A.T C^-1 A, Xty=A.T C^-1 u, yty=u.T C^-1 u, n=rank(C)+1, X_colmeans=0, y_mean=0. Zero padding/rotation gives an equivalent centered design with rank+1 rows. Fixed residual variance preserves the score likelihood.
score_adapter.background: Identical CADE nuisance profiling and final stable-qm calibration. SuSiE estimates each response separately; CADE pools prior hyperparameters across four responses. This is a stated prior-pooling difference, not an information/input advantage.
score_adapter.audit: Retain package convergence, warnings, fit iterations, exact version and hashes. No oracle settings.

controlled.aggregation: All conditions retained. Pair seed and condition. MCSE by replicate after averaging conditions; not 4000 independent designs.

spatial.reuse_existing_models: Hash-verified frozen scores; validate generator replay before joining. Add only SuSiE-score hurdle.
spatial.aggregation: Existing 32 factorial conditions, 11 stress mechanisms, 12 replicates and both directions. Equal condition weights; paired uncertainty by replicate. No tuning to test outcomes.

native.gene_selection: Published Srf-neighbour DE genes (first three) and a published Lrrk2-neighbour response (Map2k6), chosen before loading their counts. Exact symbols absent from all historical notebook code cells. Not selected by their measured detection rates.

expected_directions.basis: Published inverse association with Lrrk2 in orthogonal validation; secondary expectation.

native.heldout_scope: Readouts never fitted in sections12-21; literature panel source channels also not fitted in that pilot. Same two chips and QC-selected receiver population, not new independent animals. Published findings came partly from this study, not independent biological ground truth.
native.receivers: Use exact frozen pilot receiver cell IDs and five nuisance columns. Full raw counts only supply the four new outcomes. No new cell-type inference or expression-derived covariates.
native.sources: Single-barcode, endogenous library count100..6000, mitochondrial fraction<=0.20, raw geometry component size>=200; verify historical rule. Source IDs/metadata inspected before freezing; no outcome-based replacement.

primary_geometry.purpose: Prespecified overlapping nested exposures; report observed and nuisance-residualized correlations, do not select by correlations.

sensitivity_geometry.scope: Full fits and cross-chip prediction only; not an additional selection opportunity.

native.support: Fit and retain every fixed channel/gene. Label literature direction checks adequately supported only if >=10 sources in>=3 blocks and>=20 positive receivers in>=3 blocks on each chip. Otherwise descriptive; do not replace genes or channels.
primary_metrics: Cross-chip combined source-effect cosine on one common covariate reference (equal chip/block weights), with effect energy and nonzero count reported; zero vectors yield undefined cosine, not perfect agreement.
Cross-chip native block prediction MSE and paired source-on minus source-zero MSE, using training-only fit and fixed nuisance coefficients.
Delete-one-of-five-block-groups sensitivity of combined effects, normalized by full-fit energy; always accompany with absolute energy and zero-estimator reference.
native.common_reference: Stack fixed receiver covariates from both chips, outcomes excluded. Evaluate each separately fitted model on this same reference. No reference outcome or result used for fitting.

null_reference.scheme: Shuffle all18 single-barcode target labels within geometry component, component-origin500um source block, and barcode-count stratum1 versus>=2. Source positions, target counts per stratum, receivers and native outcomes fixed. Report movable labels.
null_reference.tests: Per-chip global and16 target-by-gene source-contrast energies. Rank p=(1+number perm>=observed)/100; BH across16 within chip/model/panel. These are exchangeability-conditional reference tests, not known true-null error rates.
null_reference.positive_control: Four prespecified literature directions and evidence across both chips; no synthetic signal.
null_reference.negative_control: mSafe source is a locus control, not proof of no bystander effect. No housekeeping gene is declared a true null.

resampling.grouping: Sort block IDs by SHA256(seed|block), assign round robin. Delete each group and refit all models. Prediction reference fixed; report failed fits and unsupported folds.

native.count_scale: Native integer UMI, hurdle q times clipped positive-linear m, same as frozen method. No injections or test-mean calibration.

failure_policy: Record all failures/nonconvergence. No silent replacement or seed deletion. Technical corrections are versioned amendments. Never change models, genes, exposure radii, thresholds or metrics after outcomes.
interpretation: No requirement that CADE win. Official SuSiE is an input-matched correlation-aware comparator; prior and inference differ. Native stability alone is not accuracy or a causal discovery. Test holdout features, not independent cohort generalization.
